node.statement: Let gamma=q+epsilon_r*q+q^2 and rho=delta-C_pol*(epsilon_r*delta+delta^2). The strict hypothesis gamma<rho and Z_t in calUbar_gamma imply ||Z_t^dagger bold-dot Z_t-J||<=2gamma<2rho, while Z_t has a right inverse; hence Z_t belongs to the strict set calU_rho.
